Two samples of the pipeline on Opus 5.5 over the 17 evaluation papers of ROADMAP 3.2–3.6 (claims within tolerance of the paper's printed value); the six papers of ROADMAP 3.7 have one sample and are not in this table.  *Sample 1* is the model-matched row used everywhere else in this report: the API run (`claude-opus-5-5`) for Grier, Leeson, Manekin and Montero and the first oracle run for the other thirteen.  *Sample 2* is a second oracle run (label `desktop-opus-run2`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-13papers-all-modes-2026-10-23.json` for the 13 earlier papers, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-4papers-all-modes-2026-11-02.json` for the four of ROADMAP 3.6), so for the four API papers the two samples differ in route as well as draw.  The agent column is its first sample.  *Cells identical*, *mean* and *max abs. diff* compare the two pipeline samples cell by cell (paper × mode).
